The role is fundamental to ensuring the smooth day-to-day operation of the service and maintaining a positive patient experience. Provide a comprehensive administrative service to support the Psychological Medicine Service and multidisciplinary team. Manage patient pathways by processing referrals, booking appointments and maintaining accurate patient records using the Trust's Electronic Patient Record (EPR) systems. Provide reception cover, acting as the first point of contact for patients and visitors, delivering a professional and compassionate service. Produce and process clinical correspondence using digital transcription systems, ensuring Trust timescales and quality standards are met. Monitor and manage shared email inboxes, process incoming correspondence and respond to patient, referrer and stakeholder enquiries promptly and appropriately. Support Referral to Treatment (RTT) pathways by ensuring accurate data entry, clinic preparation, patient check-in/check-out and clinic cash-up processes. Maintain high standards of data quality, confidentiality and customer service while supporting the smooth day-to-day running of the department. Work collaboratively with clinical and administrative colleagues, contributing to service improvement initiatives and providing flexible administrative support to ensure continuity of patient care MAIN PURPOSE OF POST: Patient administration underpins the patient journey and supports the clinical teams in delivering high quality patient care and can make a real difference to the patient experience. title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Robert Half are delighted to be partnering with a small, ambitious and friendly business based in Oxford. They are looking for an Accounts Assistant to take ownership of an important part of the financial operation.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with finance experience who enjoys variety, likes working with people as well as numbers, and wants to play a genuinely meaningful role within a growing, close-knit business.

The Role

Reporting into the finance team, you will play a key role in ensuring customer accounts are accurately maintained and payments are received and allocated promptly. You'll be working with customers from around the world across multiple currencies, and the role goes well beyond routine accounts receivable. You'll also liaise with sales and marketing colleagues, resolve customer queries, produce reports, and get involved in wider business projects.

Key responsibilities include:
- Allocating customer payments accurately against invoices and reconciling bank accounts
- Preparing and importing bank statements into Xero
- Proactively chasing outstanding debts by phone and email, maintaining accurate records of collection activity
- Managing the accounts receivable inbox and resolving customer queries promptly and professionally
- Producing and reviewing the monthly Aged Debtors Report
- Maintaining and updating debt-tracking spreadsheets and reports
- Supporting the wider finance function with ad hoc projects and administration

About You
- Previous experience in an accounts receivable, credit control or accounts assistant role
- Confident working with multiple currencies and reconciling accounts
- Strong communication skills, with the confidence to proactively chase payments
- Organised, accurate and comfortable managing a varied workload
- Experience with Xero (or similar accounting software) is desirable but not essential

What's on Offer
- Salary of up to £32,000, depending on experience
- Hybrid working - 3 days in the office, 2 days from home
- Discretionary annual bonus
- 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays, rising with service (up to 30 days)
- Early finish on Fridays
- Company pension scheme
- Quarterly team socials and Christmas party
- Free on-site parking
- The chance to join a small, fun team with genuine international reach

Apply Now

If you're looking for a varied finance role within a supportive, sociable team where you can make a real impact, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today or contact Robert Half's Oxford office for a confidential conversation.

Robert Half Ltd acts as an employment business for temporary positions and an employment agency for permanent positions. Robert Half is committed to diversity, equity and inclusion. Suitable candidates with equivalent qualifications and more or less experience can apply. Rates of pay and salary ranges are dependent upon your experience, qualifications and training. If you wish to apply, please read our Privacy Notice describing how we may process, disclose and store your personal data:

title: Lead Generation & Marketing Executive
description:
Lead Generation & Marketing Executive
Salary: £30,000 per annum
Location: Oxford or Solihull (1 day per week in either office, 4 days working from home)
Contract: Full Time
Benefits: 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
About the Opportunity
Are you a proactive marketer with a passion for lead generation, digital campaigns and business growth?
We're looking for a Lead Generation & Marketing Executive to play a key role in supporting the continued growth of a successful training and development business. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys combining marketing, research and commercial activity to generate quality opportunities for a sales team.
Working closely with the Business Development Manager, you'll be responsible for planning and delivering targeted campaigns, developing prospect databases, producing engaging content and generating qualified leads through email, LinkedIn and digital outreach.
This is a hybrid role offering flexibility, autonomy and the opportunity to make a tangible impact on business growth.
What You'll Be Doing
Campaign Management
- Plan and deliver targeted email and LinkedIn marketing campaigns.
- Build and maintain campaign calendars aligned with business priorities.
- Create engaging email campaigns, newsletters and nurture sequences.
- Segment audiences and personalise content to maximise engagement.
- Analyse campaign performance and continually optimise results.

Lead Generation & Prospect Research
- Research target organisations and identify potential training needs.
- Identify and engage decision-makers across HR, Learning & Development, Operations and Senior Leadership teams.
- Generate opportunities through email outreach, LinkedIn activity, inbound enquiries and follow-up campaigns.
- Qualify opportunities before passing them to the Business Development Manager.
- Provide detailed prospect intelligence and recommended next steps.

Content & Social Media
- Create and manage engaging LinkedIn content that promotes training programmes and supports lead-generation activity.
- Develop content calendars and maintain a consistent posting schedule.
- Produce campaign copy, social media content, landing pages and marketing collateral.
- Monitor social engagement and identify potential commercial opportunities.

CRM, Reporting & Data Management
- Maintain accurate CRM records and prospect databases.
- Track campaign performance and lead-generation activity.
- Produce regular reports and insights to support commercial decision-making.
- Monitor key performance indicators and identify opportunities for improvement.

Marketing Technology & AI
- Utilise AI tools to support campaign delivery, prospect research and content creation.
- Review and refine AI-generated content to ensure quality and brand alignment.
- Develop templates, workflows and processes that improve efficiency.
- Maintain compliance with company data protection and information security policies.

What We're Looking For
Essential Experience
- Previous experience in marketing, lead generation, sales support or a similar commercial role.
- Experience creating and managing email marketing campaigns.
- Strong research and database management skills.
- Confidence using LinkedIn for marketing and lead-generation activities.
- Excellent written communication skills.
- Experience using CRM systems and reporting tools.
- Strong organisation skills and attention to detail.
- A proactive and commercially-minded approach.

Desirable Experience
- Experience within apprenticeships, training, education or Learning & Development.
- Knowledge of marketing automation platforms.
- Experience using AI tools to support marketing activity and lead generation.

What Success Looks Like
- Generating qualified opportunities for the Business Development team.
- Delivering successful marketing campaigns with strong engagement rates.
- Growing and maintaining a high-quality prospect database.
- Increasing LinkedIn engagement and audience reach.
- Maintaining accurate CRM data and reporting.
- Contributing directly to business growth and pipeline development.

Why Join Us?
- Hybrid working model with significant flexibility.
- Opportunity to make a visible impact on business growth.
- Autonomy to develop and influence marketing activity.
- Work within a growing and innovative training business.
- Develop your skills across marketing, lead generation, AI and business development.
- 25 days holiday plus bank holidays.
